Class CulturalKnowledgeMetricsHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.metrics.CulturalKnowledgeMetricsHelper
public final class CulturalKnowledgeMetricsHelper extends Object

CulturalKnowledgeMetricsHelper

Calculates cognitive complexity, literacy transitions, collective memory stocks, Shannon information bandwidth, systemic interdependence, and post-shock reconstruction capabilities (Jack Goody, Joseph Henrich, W. Brian Arthur, Peter Turchin).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • getLiteracyRate

      public double getLiteracyRate()
      Evaluates global literacy rate (%) endogenously across active human populations based on Shannon informational density (I/N bits/capita), collective memory stock, and physical transmission media (Goody 1986, Buringh & van Zanden 2009, Graff 1987).

      Universal across deep time, future eras, and exoplanetary colonization: Space colonists arriving with minimal physical ground infrastructure but high knowledge stocks retain their full adult literacy (e.g. 99.5%), while prehistoric oral hunter-gatherers ($I \le 20\text{ bits/hab}$) evaluate smoothly to 0.0% without artificial calendar-year gating.

      Returns:
      global literacy rate in $[0.0, 99.5]$ %
